name: onstage
description: Plan church services in OnStage: events, who serves where, setlists, songs with chords and reports.

interface.longDescription:
OnStage is a service planning platform for churches. Connect your OnStage team and plan in plain language.

- See upcoming events, their setlists, and who serves in each position
- Search your song library and read songs with chords (ChordPro)
- Add songs and events in bulk: from a spreadsheet, a PDF, or a rotation you describe
- Change setlists, participants, reminders, dates and locations of existing events
- Reports: who served how often, song usage, availability

Every upload and edit is previewed first and applied only after you confirm, and uploads can be undone within 7 days. ChatGPT acts as you, with your permissions in the team. Only team owners and admins can connect.
defaultPrompt: Who is serving at Sunday's service, and what's on the setlist?
Plan our Sunday services for next month.
Which songs did we use most this year?

positive.description: See the next service with its team and setlist
positive.prompt: What events do we have in the next 30 days, and who is serving at the next one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming events with dates, and for the next one the people serving in each position and the ordered setlist.

positive.prompt: Show me the chords for Review Song.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song by title and shows its key and sections with inline chords.

positive.description: Add a song from ChordPro, preview then apply
positive.prompt: Add this song to OnStage: {title: Review Song} {key: G} {start_of_verse: Verse 1} [G]This is a [C]test [D]line {end_of_verse}
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of the song first; after the user confirms, applies it and reports the song as created.

positive.description: Create a month of services from a rotation, then undo
positive.prompt: Create Sunday services at 10:30 for the next 3 Sundays with me serving, and put Review Song on the setlist. Then undo that upload.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews 3 draft events with the participant and setlist, applies them after confirmation without notifying anyone, then removes them on undo.

positive.prompt: Which songs did we use most this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the songs ranked by how many events they were used in this year.

negative.description: Another team's data is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the events of another church that uses OnStage.
Email everyone on my team the setlist for Sunday.
Find the lyrics of a song that isn't in my OnStage library and print them in full.

es-ES.subtitle: Planifica servicios
es-ES.description: OnStage es una plataforma de planificación de servicios para iglesias. Conecta tu equipo de OnStage y planifica con lenguaje natural: consulta los próximos eventos, sus repertorios y quién sirve en cada posición; busca canciones con acordes; añade canciones y eventos en bloque; cambia repertorios, participantes, recordatorios, fechas y ubicaciones; y obtén informes de servicio, uso de canciones y disponibilidad. Cada carga y cambio se muestra primero como vista previa y solo se aplica cuando confirmas; las cargas se pueden deshacer durante 7 días. Solo los propietarios y administradores del equipo pueden conectarse.

pt-BR.subtitle: Planeje cultos
pt-BR.description: OnStage é uma plataforma de planejamento de cultos para igrejas. Conecte sua equipe do OnStage e planeje em linguagem natural: veja os próximos eventos, seus repertórios e quem serve em cada posição; busque músicas com cifras; adicione músicas e eventos em lote; altere repertórios, participantes, lembretes, datas e locais; e obtenha relatórios de escalas, uso de músicas e disponibilidade. Cada envio e alteração aparece primeiro como prévia e só é aplicado depois que você confirma; os envios podem ser desfeitos em até 7 dias. Somente proprietários e administradores da equipe podem se conectar.

ro-RO.subtitle: Planifică slujbele
ro-RO.description: OnStage este o platformă de planificare a slujbelor pentru biserici. Conectează-ți echipa din OnStage și planifică în limbaj natural: vezi evenimentele următoare, repertoriul lor și cine slujește pe fiecare poziție; caută cântări cu acorduri; adaugă cântări și evenimente în bloc; modifică repertorii, participanți, mementouri, date și locații; și primește rapoarte despre slujire, folosirea cântărilor și disponibilitate. Fiecare încărcare și modificare apare mai întâi ca previzualizare și se aplică doar după ce confirmi; încărcările pot fi anulate timp de 7 zile. Doar proprietarii și administratorii echipei se pot conecta.
